details.name: Music Playback Probe
details.summary: Continuous music with track, loop and volume controls; quieter 3 percent default
details.description:
How to play
1. Install and enable the mod in Garrison.
2. Press Play.
3. In a custom lobby, choose:
   Tuning Pack: "Music Playback Probe".
   Game Mode: "Music Playback Probe".
details.changelog: Remove timed auditions; add independent custom music controls.
